'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Freeman LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Freeman]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''2'''. Line 1 Shmi's Hut → start [[There Is Good In Him / Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]] (QA objective). L12 Dash Rendar (V); L40 Luke's Bionic Hand (V). R56–57 Communing + Wokling (V) as sheet-written.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
